scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Franklin & Marshall College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 9,634 applied, 3,047 admitted (the CDS prints 32%), 488 enrolled (16%); residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International first-years: 4,658 applied, 627 admitted, 130 enrolled. The ED figures cover Early Decision (all plans combined): 860 applications, 254 admitted. The CDS leaves the waitlist (C2) blank and does not report high school GPA (C11/C12 are blank), so those fields are empty. SAT/ACT submission is optional: 31% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT (153 students) and 7% ACT (35 students). Percentiles are for those submitters only.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set G1/G5: tuition $72,950, required fees $470 (the CDS lists $260 in its all-undergraduates column), on-campus food and housing $16,710 (housing $9,800 + food $6,910), books and supplies $800, other expenses $1,350 (transportation, $200, is not included in other_usd). The CDS prints these under '2025-26 costs' although it also ticks '2025-2026 costs not available at this time'. No total cost of attendance is printed. The college's own cost page (fandm.edu/financial-aid/cost-of-attendance.html) lists academic year 2026-27 at tuition $74,770, health fee $146, activity fee $200, housing $12,080, meal plan $7,240 (all-access), books $800, loan fees $55, personal $1,350, transportation $400, total $97,041. Institutional aid for nonresidents (CDS H6, 2025-26 estimated column): need-based and non-need-based aid available; 276 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received it, average $56,601 (total $15,621,833).
